user.description: This integration talks to Assist. Pick the Klar NLU App or the bundled engine. You can switch later in Configure. Do not run both as the engine host at once. Release channel can be changed later.

init.title: Klar NLU
init.description: Voice, Assist languages, and the LLM live in the Klar operator UI (Settings). This form only connects the engine: URL, token, and channel. {apps}

data.assist_filter: Only control entities exposed to Assist

data_description.mode: App vs bundled engine. Switch anytime. The integration sidebar only appears for the bundled engine.
data_description.token: Same token as the Klar add-on. Needed for overlay writes from Home Assistant.
data_description.assist_filter: Developer option. On (default): Klar changes only what Assist may see. Off: match hidden sensors and switches too — easier to hit the wrong device.
data_description.channel: Stable vs staging for the host you picked above. App uses that add-on; bundled engine downloads that GitHub release. A custom URL is left alone.
